Rock: person search by name.description: Find people by name, newest Rock conventions: living people only, matching nick name, first name or last name.

Rock: person search by email or phone.description: Find people by email address, with their phone numbers. PhoneNumber.PersonId is a real PersonId, one of the few in Rock that is not an alias id.
body: LEFT JOIN PhoneNumber pn ON pn.PersonId = p.Id
LEFT JOIN DefinedValue dv ON dv.Id = pn.NumberTypeValueId

Rock: attendance in a date range.description: Who attended which group between two dates. Attendance carries almost nothing itself: the group, date and schedule all come from AttendanceOccurrence.
body: INNER JOIN AttendanceOccurrence ao ON ao.Id = a.OccurrenceId
INNER JOIN [Group] g ON g.Id = ao.GroupId
INNER JOIN PersonAlias pa ON pa.Id = a.PersonAliasId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = pa.PersonId

Rock: giving by person and date range.description: Gifts in a date range with the giver and the fund. Amounts live on FinancialTransactionDetail because one gift can be split across accounts.
body: INNER JOIN FinancialTransactionDetail ftd ON ftd.TransactionId = ft.Id
INNER JOIN FinancialAccount fa ON fa.Id = ftd.AccountId
INNER JOIN PersonAlias pa ON pa.Id = ft.AuthorizedPersonAliasId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = pa.PersonId

Rock: total giving per person.description: Total given per person in a date range, summed over the detail rows and grouped by the giver.
body: INNER JOIN FinancialTransactionDetail ftd ON ftd.TransactionId = ft.Id
INNER JOIN PersonAlias pa ON pa.Id = ft.AuthorizedPersonAliasId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = pa.PersonId

Rock: group members with roles.description: The members of one group with their role and status. GroupMember.PersonId is a real PersonId. Remember that families are groups too.
body: INNER JOIN [Group] g ON g.Id = gm.GroupId
INNER JOIN GroupTypeRole gtr ON gtr.Id = gm.GroupRoleId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = gm.PersonId

Rock: defined value lookup.description: The entries of one defined type, in their configured order. Every column ending in ValueId points at DefinedValue.
body: INNER JOIN DefinedType dt ON dt.Id = dv.DefinedTypeId

Rock: attribute values for an entity typ.description: The values of one custom field. AttributeValue.EntityId is polymorphic, so always filter through Attribute.EntityTypeId before joining anything to it.
body: INNER JOIN Attribute a ON a.Id = av.AttributeId
INNER JOIN EntityType et ON et.Id = a.EntityTypeId

Rock: recent registrations.description: Registrations submitted in the last few days, with the registrar and the instance they belong to.
body: INNER JOIN RegistrationInstance ri ON ri.Id = r.RegistrationInstanceId
INNER JOIN PersonAlias pa ON pa.Id = r.PersonAliasId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = pa.PersonId

Rock: communication recipient status.description: Per-recipient state of one communication: sent, opened, failed and why.
body: INNER JOIN Communication c ON c.Id = cr.CommunicationId
INNER JOIN PersonAlias pa ON pa.Id = cr.PersonAliasId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = pa.PersonId

Rock: active connection requests.description: Open connection requests with the requester and the assigned connector. Both person references go through PersonAlias.
body: INNER JOIN ConnectionOpportunity co ON co.Id = cr.ConnectionOpportunityId
INNER JOIN PersonAlias pa ON pa.Id = cr.PersonAliasId
INNER JOIN Person p ON p.Id = pa.PersonId
LEFT JOIN PersonAlias cpa ON cpa.Id = cr.ConnectorPersonAliasId
LEFT JOIN Person connector ON connector.Id = cpa.PersonId
